# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

All three required inputs are present and listed in the factor table, so the figure can be computed.

| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | ✅ In table |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 500.5 tonnes | ✅ Provided |

**Default SEE** for CN 7201 and India: **2.53 tCO2e/t**

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 500.5 t
= 1,266.265 tCO2e

## Result

**Embedded emissions = 1,266.27 tCO2e**

The unrounded result ends exactly on a 5 in the third decimal place. Standard rounding (half up) gives 1,266.27. If your reporting system uses banker's rounding (half to even), it would give 1,266.26. The ruleset does not specify a rounding convention.
